entities.name: The Thorn
entities.description: A wizard, possibly a Planeswalker, who works the storm lines and death pools and is Tempé's main foe.

entities.name: Tempé
entities.description: The Thorn's foe, who fears him and won the firesword Soulslayer from him.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: A magical firesword won by Tempé from the Thorn.

entities.name: Parting
entities.description: An event before which Tempé won Soulslayer.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: An event at which Tempé and the Thorn were still in conflict.

events.summary: Tempé won the firesword Soulslayer from the Thorn in a duel before the Parting.
events.quote: Tempé won the magical firesword Soulslayer from the Thorn in a duel before the Parting.

relations.note: He is her main foe and they were still in conflict.
